summary: Adds a dead-branch cleanup fallback tool for agents to detect and optionally delete merged remote branches with no open PR.
migration_impact: Operators and agents can run a dry-run branch cleanup before applying deletions, reducing orphaned-branch drift after merge automation misses cleanup.
migration_guidance: 1. Use `gh plate release cleanup-branches` to preview dead branch candidates.
2. Use `gh plate release cleanup-branches --apply` to delete candidates after review.
3. For MCP workflows, call `plate_release_cleanup_branches` with `apply: false` first, then `apply: true`.
agent_notes: The cleanup tool automatically excludes protected/default/release namespace branches and only targets branches merged into base with no open PR.
